title: MATH 3042 Statistics · Quiz 9
subtitle: The next lab quiz as one picture: the pile of sample results, the confidence interval for p, and the QQ plot
description: Quiz 9 built like an animated explainer: one picture, the pile of sample results, drawn from nothing and then reused for everything. Four film-style animations (the pile of p-hat and X-bar, the pile at every sample size, the flip from margin of error to confidence interval, a QQ plot built point by point), one short lesson per idea in the instructor's numbers, the R for the posted Part 2 template, two mock quizzes in the real two-part format, and a one-page know-cold sheet.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 9
**In the lab session.** Part 1 is paper and pencil with a calculator (10 marks); Part 2 is RStudio, filling in the posted notebook template (10 marks). The scope: the sampling distributions of p-hat and X-bar (notes 6.1 and 6.3 up to page 93, and the sampling lab), confidence intervals for a proportion (notes 6.2 and the confidence-interval practice problems 1 and 2), and normality testing with a QQ plot. The formula sheet and the Z table are handed out. No makeups.
:::
